name: Archaeomancer's Map

abilities.text: When ~ enters, search your library for up to two basic Plains cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if that player controls more lands than you, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.

notes: The intervening clause 'if that player controls more lands than you' is written as the core condition opponent-more-lands ('an opponent controls more lands than you'); the two are identical in a two-player game and differ only when a THIRD player has the land advantage instead of the one whose land entered. No core condition names the triggering player's own land count.

issues: Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if THAT PLAYER controls more lands than you, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. — expected The intervening-if is about the controller of the land that just entered — no other opponent's land count matters. — scripted intervening {kind:'opponent-more-lands'} — characteristics.ts:418 returns true if ANY opponent has more lands than you (`opps.some(...)`). In the 4-seat games the sandbox runs, a land entering under a land-poor opponent still turns the ability on because a third player is ahead. No condition kind expresses 'that player'. — CR 603.4, 109.5

... if that player controls more lands than you ... — expected an intervening-if is checked twice — on trigger and again on resolution; if false on resolution the ability does nothing — scripted game.ts:2208 evaluates ability.intervening only when the trigger is put on the stack; it is never re-checked as the trigger resolves. Engine gap, but the clause is under-enforced as written. — CR 603.4

...you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. — expected one 'you may' decision on resolution — scripted ability-level optional:true AND put-from-hand optional:true. Only the effect-level flag is read by the engine (game.ts:1122 area / exact:false); TriggeredAbility.optional has no reader in src/engine — dead, duplicated metadata rather than a behavioural bug. — CR 603.1

When this artifact enters, search your library for up to two basic Plains cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. — expected up to two (may find fewer/none), reveal, to hand, shuffle — scripted search {basic:true, subtypes:['Plains'], count:2, optional:true, reveal:true, to:'hand'} — correct; optional:true is what makes the choice non-exact. — CR 701.19

Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if THAT PLAYER controls more lands than you, you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. — expected The intervening-if is about the controller of the land that just entered. — scripted intervening {kind:'opponent-more-lands'} — characteristics.ts evaluates `some opponent has more lands than you`. In a 4-seat game a land entering under a land-poor opponent still enables the trigger whenever any other opponent is ahead. No condition variant expresses 'that player'; the notes disclose it but the clause is still wrong. — CR CR 603.4, 109.5

Whenever a land an opponent controls enters, if that player controls more lands than you… — expected Intervening-if is checked both on trigger and again on resolution. — scripted The engine checks `ability.intervening` only when queueing the trigger; it is never re-checked on resolution, so the land drop still happens if the condition stops being true. — CR CR 603.4

…you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield. — expected One 'you may' decision on resolution. — scripted Ability-level `optional:true` PLUS put-from-hand `optional:true`. Ability-level `optional` has no reader in src/engine (only render.ts consumes it), so behaviour is right by accident — dead/misleading metadata rather than a behavioural bug. — CR CR 603.1

When this artifact enters, search your library for up to two basic Plains cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle. — expected Up to two (may find fewer or none), revealed, to hand, then shuffle. — scripted search {count:2, optional:true, basic:true, subtypes:['Plains'], reveal:true, to:'hand'} — game.ts:1277 uses `exact: !e.optional`, so 0-2 is allowed, and the shuffle is unconditional. Correct. — CR CR 701.19
